description: A free-running clock with a main output and two more that multiply or divide it

params.text: Sets the tempo of the main clock, 40 to 200 BPM
Divides or multiplies the main clock for the first of the two scaled outputs, stepping through divide by 8, 6, 4, 3 and 2, then times 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 and 8
Divides or multiplies the main clock for the second of the two scaled outputs, stepping through divide by 24, 12, 8, 4 and 2, then times 1, 2, 4, 8, 12 and 24

outputs.text: Carries the main clock at the tempo the BPM knob sets, 10V high
Carries the first of the two scaled clocks, 10V high
Carries the second of the two scaled clocks, 10V high

notes: there is no clock input, so the module cannot be locked to anything else; it runs from its own BPM knob
moving either scaling knob restarts that output in step with the main clock
menu: Output multiplier: x1, x2, x4, x8, x16 — speeds up all three outputs together, so at x4 the module runs four times faster than the BPM knob reads
Trigger mode: Trigger, Gate, Original — sets the pulse length: Gate half the output's own cycle, Trigger a forty-eighth of a main-clock cycle, Original half the cycle capped at half a main one
